IOH -100 nA bound at 25 C, VPU10V; VOL bound at VDD5V. Does not establish full-temperature 3.3 V wired gate operation.
IOZ50pA typical only. Full-range VOL300mV specified at 50uA, below present R43 drive load near 0.3mA. Not a qualified drop-in.
